taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-16 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 312.0 | 6.08 | 6.08
2 | 794.3 | 14.76 | 20.84
3 | 884.4 | 3.48 | 24.32
4 | 1280.2 | 10.95 | 35.27
5 | 4929.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-16
Curve type: AAA-type (continuously ascending resistivity, hard-rock sequence)
Aquifer depth: 6.08 – 24.32 m (weathered/fractured zone, Layers 2–3; ρ = 794–884 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Focus drilling and screen placement within the 6–24 m weathered/fractured interval, as this offers the best secondary-porosity aquifer potential in this basement setting. Resistivity rises sharply below ~35 m (Layer 5, ~4929 Ω·m), indicating fresh, largely impermeable bedrock, so further penetration beyond this depth is unlikely to improve yield unless fracture zones are logged during drilling.
